questions.question: Ez az autó ___, mint a másik. (gyors)
questions.answer: gyorsabb - This car is faster than the other
questions.translate: This car is faster than the other

questions.question: Péter a ___ tanuló az osztályban. (jó)
questions.answer: legjobb - Peter is the best student in the class
questions.translate: Peter is the best student in the class

questions.question: Anna ___, mint Kata. (magas)
questions.answer: magasabb - Anna is taller than Kata

questions.question: Ez a feladat ___ volt, mint gondoltam. (könnyű)
questions.answer: könnyebb - This task was easier than I thought
questions.translate: This task was easier than I thought

questions.question: A tegnapi film volt a ___, amit valaha láttam. (rossz)
questions.answer: legrosszabb - Yesterday's movie was the worst I've ever seen

questions.question: A víz ___, mint a levegő. (nehez)
